meta.description: Logic for suggesting recipes based on available ingredients.

database.method: Whisk eggs and liquid. Pour fast over sautéed mixins in skillet. Cook until set. Broil top.
Sauté protein. Remove. Sauté veggies. Return protein. Add sauce. Serve over base.
Boil pasta. Reserve water. Sauté add-ins with sauce base. Toss pasta with sauce and water.
Sauté aromatics. Add liquid and sturdy ingredients. Simmer until tender. Add soft ingredients at end.
Cook oats in salted liquid. Top with savory ingredients.

logic.instruction: Input user's available list. Scan 'database'. Return recipes where user has Base + at least 1 item from other categories.
